    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is here — the ultimate tool to support you as you open a new chapter in life. Ultra slim and light, with a massive bright display, long-lasting battery and intelligent AI-driven features, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is a powerhouse for learning on the move. Fuel your curiosity as Tab helps you explore the information you need with superior performance and intuitive, optimised experiences for note-taking, brainstorming and more. Use the in-box S Pen to make learning more interactive, organise your ideas with ease and work towards your personal goals more effectively.

    MEET YOUR NEW AI TAB

    Highlights

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra in Gray shown from the side to showcase the ultra-slim design, then turns to show the back with Samsung logo and rear cameras, then turns forward to show the massive 14.6-inch display, the in-box hexagonal S Pen and another Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra behind, facing backward.1

    Thin and light. 1

    S Pen in the box.

    Up to 23 hrs battery.

    Our biggest display. 2

    IP68-rated protection. 3

    DESIGN

    Thin and light, carry it everywhere.

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra in Gray shown horizontally from the side view, showcasing the ultra-slim and sleek design. Then, the device turns slightly forward to show the expansive 14.6-inch display and slim bezel with a colourful wallpaper onscreen. The device flips backward to show the back in full with the Samsung logo and rear cameras visible, then the device turns forward to showcase the display in full with the in-box hexagonal S Pen pointed at the display and another Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra in Gray behind, facing backward.4

    Ultra slim and sleek. Signature look.

    Amazingly thin and light, with meticulously crafted details and two classy colourways — every angle of Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is a marvel to look at. Even with an incredibly large and bright 14.6-inch display, Tab stays unbelievably slim at 5.1 mm and weighs only 692 g. Complemented by the hexagon-shaped S Pen, it makes a bold statement anywhere you go. Available in sophisticated grey and Silver, the iconic design is accentuated by elegant details like the integrated mono-tone finish on the dual-camera system for a signature Ultra look.

    S PEN

    S Pen in the box. Write naturally, draw easily.

    Creative Studio with S Pen. New ways to create.

    Discover exciting ways to use your imagination with Creative Studio on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and the hexagonal S Pen. The Galaxy AI-powered creation tool with Nano Banana integration adds more possibilities to generate and refine images, turn drawings into images using S Pen and create personalised images with new templates like invitations, stickers and profile cards. Seamlessly combine sketches, images and text prompts with AI to create unique visual content right on your Tab. Then, use the in-box S Pen to add the final strokes and complete your creations. 5

    Adobe Photoshop open on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, displaying sky with clouds. On the left menu bar, a layer is selected with S Pen. Then, S Pen taps on a cloud to separate it, then paste it on a poster with Earth and text International Business Conference, Beyond Borders, Global Business Summit 2027.6

    Adobe Photoshop. Now on Galaxy Tab for the first time.

    For the first time ever available on an Android tablet, Adobe Photoshop arrives on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, letting you experience pro-grade creativity in your hands. Optimised for Tab's expansive display, Photoshop gives you a spacious canvas for precise editing with a streamlined, easy-to-use layout. It works well with S Pen, too, including instant access to Quick Tools, letting you adjust settings in a flash. And with low-latency responsiveness, every stroke feels smooth and intuitive. Edit high-resolution images, create digital artwork or fine-tune designs wherever creativity takes you. 6

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra in landscape mode with a split-screen view of Samsung Notes app on the left and App Drawer on the right. Notability app is launched on the right and S Pen Quick Tools are used to adjust colour settings, then S Pen is used to underline a handwritten note in Notability app.7

    Notability. Optimised notetaking with S Pen.

    Turn your thoughts into polished notes with premium note-taking tools available in Notability on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. Optimised for use with the S Pen, Notability delivers a smooth, low-latency writing experience that feels natural from the first stroke. Use Quick Tools to switch pens, adjust settings and keep ideas flowing as you write, sketch, annotate PDFs or organise class and meeting notes on the expansive 14.6-inch display. From study sessions to creative planning, your bright ideas stay clear and ready to share. 7

    PERFORMANCE

    One charge. 23 hours.

    Equipped with a long-lasting 11600 mAh battery, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra lets you spend your time learning something new without worrying about battery life. With support for up to 23 hours of video playback on a single charge, the large-capacity battery gives you the freedom to stay productive from morning to night, whether you're making the most of your commute or studying at a coffee shop after work. And when it's time to recharge, Super Fast Charging 2.0 gets you back to what matters with less waiting.8

    Our biggest display. Our sharpest Dynamic AMOLED 2X display.

    See your bold ideas come to life on the massive 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display of Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, delivering brilliant visuals both indoors and outdoors. Paired with an ultra-slim 5.2 mm besel, the screen offers an immersive viewing experience — whether you are sketching concepts in the park, editing creative projects in the studio or streaming your favourite shows at home. The upgraded Seamless Vision Booster automatically adjusts the contrast and colour to match your surroundings for a brighter and clearer picture, even in direct sunlight.9

    Ultra fast. Our 3D Vapor Chamber keeps it that way.

    Engineered to handle intense workloads, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra features an advanced processor and upgraded 3D Vapor Chamber, delivering next-level speed while staying cool under pressure. The improved CPU, GPU and NPU effortlessly accelerate your flow — from rendering rich graphics and handling heavy multitasking to letting you enjoy AI-enabled experiences and everyday entertainment. With an enhanced thermal system that dissipates heat faster, you can edit high-resolution videos, collaborate on demanding projects or dive into gaming with reduced throttle.10

    GALAXY AI

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra in landscape mode with Messages app onscreen. Now Nudge pill button View calendar shown on top. With a tap on the View calendar pill button, Messages and Calendar apps open in split-screen Multi Window view to allow completion of follow-up actions in the Calendar app.11

    Now Nudge. Multi Window. Keep learning in flow.

    Now Nudge and Multi Window let you complete tasks quickly with intuitive follow-up actions on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. Powered by Galaxy AI, Now Nudge understands the context on your screen and provides real-time action suggestions to complete tasks, reducing the steps you need to take. Whether it’s adding an event to your calendar, pinning a location or suggesting a reply, it knows what you need even before you ask. Selecting an action automatically launches apps in Multi Window by pairing them together onscreen, so you can seamlessly complete your task with both app windows in sight. 11

    Dynamic AI Agents. Flexible assistance, your way.

    Get instant help whenever inspiration strikes with easy access to Dynamic AI Agents on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. With support for Bixby, Gemini and Perplexity, you can seamlessly switch between AI agents and choose the one that best matches your needs. Launch effortlessly by long-pressing the side button on your Tab, by tapping the Galaxy AI Key on the keyboard or just by saying a wake word. One simple action brings you the AI assistance you need to boost your productivity, generate creative ideas, draft emails, organise projects and more. 12

    Hours of notes. Summarised in seconds.

    Stay focused on what matters with useful note summaries using Note Assist on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. In the Samsung Notes app, simply tap the Galaxy AI button and select Summarise to turn lengthy notes into a concise overview. The summary appears in a convenient split-screen view on the right, letting you review the key points alongside your original notes. Choose between Standard or Detailed summaries, then copy, replace or add the summary to your note for easy organization and follow-up. 13

    GOOGLE AI PRO

    Get a 6-month trial of Google AI Pro on us with expanded access to Gemini Notebook.

    With Google AI Pro, get expanded access for organising your documents and sources to transform your content with Gemini Notebook on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, helping you study, brainstorm and create efficiently. Upload PDFs, presentations, websites, images, voice recordings and more, then ask questions based on your own materials to get relevant answers and insights. You can also create Audio Overviews, Slide Decks, Flashcards, Video Overviews and Quizzes based on your sources in just a few taps, and experience the content on the immersive large display of Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra for optimal viewing.14

    DO MORE WITH GALAXY

    Your essential apps. Designed for Galaxy Tab.

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra comes preloaded with apps like Photoshop, Notability, Goodnotes, LumaFusion, Clip Studio Paint and Notion, making it easy to design, annotate, take notes, edit, draw and stay organised from the start. You’ll also have access to optimised apps like MyScript Notes, MyScript Math, Noteshelf 3 and ArcSite, all designed to run smoothly and enhance your creative experience. 15

    4-channel audio system. Sound that surrounds you.

    Experience rich, immersive spatial sound with Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra's 4-channel audio system, wherever you watch, play or listen. The powerful 4-speaker system creates a wide and lifelike soundstage with balanced, room-filling audio that makes movies and music feel all around you. Whether you're streaming your favourite series, joining a concert livestream or taking a break with a podcast, the audio system detects the source and automatically adjusts sound settings to provide a clear, full and engaging experience without needing external speakers.

    Samsung DeX. Learn smarter with PC-like productivity.

    Samsung DeX transforms your Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra into a PC-like desktop, offering a seamless multitasking environment with up to 4 workspaces. See a thumbnail preview of each workspace on the top of your Tab's screen, move apps freely between workspaces or remove them easily to keep your workflow smooth. To use multiple apps simultaneously, just snap one of them to one side of the screen and Tab will recommend a list of apps to pair it with from your recently used apps history. 16

    GALAXY FUNDAMENTAL

     ‎ ‎

    Built to resist water and dust.

    Wrapped in enhanced Armor Aluminum and with IP68-rated protection, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is built to withstand whatever the day throws its way.17

    One UI fits all.

    Optimised especially for Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, One UI 9 helps everything flow more smoothly with a customisable home screen and multi-window views. With support for two-way and three-way split views, you can freely shift between windows with just a tap.18

    Join Galaxy. Reap the benefits.

    7x OS and security upgrades. Built to last.

    Keep your Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra supported and secure with up to 7x OS upgrades and security updates, so you can enjoy long-term use with peace of mind.19

    The connected power of Galaxy.

    Galaxy Tab and Phone. Working as one.

    Move effortlessly between your Galaxy devices to spend more time learning, creating and exploring.20

    Learn more

    Accessories. The right match for your Tab.21

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is powered by the 3 nm MediaTek Dimensity 9500 processor, delivering improved performance compared to the previous Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra, with a 61% faster NPU, 19% faster CPU and 17% faster GPU. It handles high-end gaming, 3D rendering and intensive multitasking with ease.22

    To dissipate heat efficiently, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra features a newly designed 3D Vapor chamber. This enhanced cooling solution improves upon previous vapor chamber designs, helping maintain consistent performance and manage heat during demanding workloads.23

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra offers up to 16 GB of memory and 1 TB of storage, with configurations starting at 12 GB memory and 256 GB or 512 GB of storage. All models include a microSD card slot, supporting storage expansion of up to 2 TB.24

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is just about 5.1 mm thick and weighs only about 692 g. It also features IP68-rated water and dust resistance for added durability and peace of mind during outdoor use.25

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra features a 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display (2960 x 1848, 120 Hz) with a 5.2 mm bezel, providing a more immersive viewing experience.26

    With a peak brightness of 1600 nits (1000 nits HBM), Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra's display delivers excellent visibility even in bright environments. The new Seamless Vision Booster continuously and seamlessly adjusts screen brightness and contrast based on ambient lighting for a comfortable viewing experience.27

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is a premium model featuring a large 14.6 inch display, a 11600 mAh battery, Wi-Fi 7 and an ultra-slim 5.1 mm profile, delivering powerful performance and enhanced productivity. In comparison, Galaxy Tab S12+ prioritises portability with its 12.6 inch display, lightweight 553 g (Wi-Fi model) or 555 g (5G model) design and 5.3 mm thickness. Both models are powered by the same MediaTek Dimensity 9500 processor. The choice comes down to your needs, whether you prioritise a larger display and greater productivity with Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra or a more compact and portable design with Galaxy Tab S12+.

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra delivers laptop-like productivity with its 14.6-inch display, Pro Keyboard with trackpad and Samsung DeX for a seamless productivity experience. Powered by 3 nm MediaTek Dimensity 9500 processor, it handles multitasking and creative work with ease. Premium apps like Photoshop, Notability and Clip Studio Paint provide professional tools. However, a laptop may still be required for certain specialised software. Overall, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is an excellent choice for content creation and productivity on the go.

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra comes with an S Pen that's ready to use right out of the box. The package includes a Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra device, an S Pen, a USB Type-C to Type-C data cable (3 A, 1.0 m), an ejection pin and a Quick Start Guide. Device charger is not included.

    The in-box S Pen supports ultra-low latency, delivering precise input and a natural handwriting experience.

    Compatible accessories include the Pro Keyboard (aluminium body, 1.0mm key stroke, 8,968mm² trackpad, Galaxy AI Key), Book Cover (lightweight with versatile stand), Frame Cover (Ultra-exclusive lightweight design), Book Cover Keyboard Slim (refined lightweight design with Galaxy AI Key) and Anti-Reflecting Screen Protector (1.8% low reflectance). All accessories are sold separately, and Frame Cover is exclusive to the Ultra model.

    Equipped with an 11600 mAh battery, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra offers up to 23 hours of video playback.28

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has been upgraded with 4-channel spatial sound powered by four speakers. This system creates an immersive surround sound experience that feels like sound is coming from all around you. Even 2-channel audio is processed into 4-channel sound, delivering a more immersive listening experience across different types of content.29

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra supports a range of AI features, including Now Nudge for suggesting next actions in multi-window mode, Ask anything in Samsung Browser for instant answers based on your current page and open tabs and personalised Now Brief for customised content recommendations. Automated App Action simplifies multi-step tasks, while Creative Studio transforms S Pen sketches into professional artwork. Dynamic AI Agents, including Bixby, Gemini and Perplexity, can be switched freely for flexible AI assistance tailored to your needs.30

    You can tap the dedicated Galaxy AI Key on the Pro Keyboard or Book Cover Keyboard Slim, long-press the side button or use wake words like "Hi Bixby," "Hey Google" or "Hey Perplexity."31

    Ask anything is a new AI-powered browser feature that analyses your current page, open tabs and browsing history to answer queries, summarise pages or find the best deals instantly.32

    Yes. With the Automated App Action feature, AI agents can handle multi-step tasks. For example, you can ask Gemini to book a flight on Skyscanner and a hotel on Trip.com, and it will take care of the process for you.33

    Personalised Now Brief delivers diverse, customisable content cards, recommends tailored entertainment playlists from YouTube, Spotify and Netflix, and helps organise your schedule. Customisable Cards support video (YouTube only), Weather, Calendar and more.34

    If you are a Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra user, you can enjoy a free 4-month Adobe Photoshop subscription featuring an enhanced mobile UX and AI features via Galaxy Picks, a free 6-month Notability Plus subscription, a free 6-month Clip Studio Paint EX subscription, a free 1-month Notion Business subscription and a free 1-year Goodnotes Essential subscription.35

    Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra supports up to 7x OS upgrades and security updates, providing long-term software support and enhanced protection.36

    [Diese Bewertung wurde im Rahmen einer Werbeaktion gesammelt.] Ich habe heute Morgen das neue Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra noch vor dem offiziellen Verkaufsstart bei einem Samsung Community Event testen dürfen. 😃 Das Galaxy Tab besticht durch einen riesigen 11.600 mAh Akku. Hiermit sind auch längere (bis zu 23 stündige) Videosessions möglich. Für mehr Leistung ist ein neuer Chip mit 19% CPU Leistung und ein 14,6 Zoll Bildschirm verbaut. Außerdem wird jedes Tablett mit einem S PEN und dem Creative Studio ausgeliefert. Bei dem ersten Test hat mich das Tablett mit seiner hochwertigen Optik und der Kamera überzeugt. Die ersten Bilder in Frankfurt können sich wirklich sehen lassen. 😊 Einzig bei der Einrichtung des Tabletts gab es bei mir Probleme, da ich auf meinen Smartphone nicht die Google App installiert hatte und der Anmeldeversuch als Betrugsversuch gewertet wurde. Aus meiner Sicht ist das Tablett perfekt für jeden, der gerne ein All in One Gerät haben möchte. Ich werde das Galaxy Tablett zukünftig mit einer Funktastatur als Laptop Ersatz nutzen.

    [Diese Bewertung wurde im Rahmen einer Werbeaktion gesammelt.] Ich nutze das Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra hauptsächlich für die Arbeit, zum Lesen technischer Dokumente, für Videoanrufe, zum Streamen und zur Planung von Familienaktivitäten. Das große Display ist für mich der größte Vorteil. Technische Zeichnungen, PDFs, Tabellen und lange Dokumente lassen sich viel besser lesen, und ich kann bequem zwei Apps nebeneinander geöffnet haben. So kann ich beispielsweise auf der einen Seite eine Spezifikation nachschlagen und auf der anderen Seite Notizen machen oder eine E-Mail schreiben. Die Leistung ist hervorragend. Apps öffnen sich schnell, und das Wechseln zwischen Anwendungen funktioniert flüssig. Die Einrichtung war einfach, und die Benutzeroberfläche ist intuitiv. Der Akku hält problemlos einen normalen Tag mit gemischter Nutzung durch, inklusive Surfen, Streamen und Arbeiten. Es eignet sich besonders gut für Produktivität, Unterhaltung und Multitasking. Ich würde es jedem empfehlen, der einen großen Bildschirm für die Arbeit und den Alltag benötigt.
